buildRelations: The upstream source archive supplies the Python sources used by the pinned wheel. The exported native build tools describe the application freeze; source acquisition does not certify a user-modified freeze.

The local source-only overlay helper and rebuild guide preserve the full parent inventory and all 155 DLL identities. Actual user-modified ASE import/freeze/operation acceptance is tracked separately.
An isolated existing-source ASE change was actually imported, frozen and loaded by a crystal-modeling request with an observed marker; default source/locks were unchanged.
The library tar.xz and Python-binding tar.gz are the distinct archives named by their respective upstream binary-package recipes. Retain each recipe and its platform-specific patches.
Bundled source snapshots and resolved Conda host dependencies are distinct; the recipes record the actual host versions.
Use the pinned release source with its original shared-library build recipe. Do not substitute vendored older snapshots for the resolved host dependency versions.
Retain the original build recipe and wrap.patch. The recipe test-data fallback uses mstore head; its historical test-data resolution is not certified by this source provision.
The original Windows recipe applies CMakeLists.txt.patch, config.h.patch and configure.cmake.patch. Other retained upstream recipe patches have platform-specific applicability.
The archive is the exact Chromium FFmpeg fork commit; its archive Git tree is c60e6b597c312801ce91d81110442d40fbf4d672.
Electron 44.7.0 patches/config.json selects patches/ffmpeg/.patches. The retained link_with_loader_path.patch affects the macOS linker branch.

The distributed Electron release uses Chrome branding, proprietary_codecs=true and is_component_ffmpeg=true. build/args/ffmpeg.gn is the separate Chromium-branding, proprietary_codecs=false alternative build configuration.
Chromium media/ffmpeg helper scripts are included. The complete Chromium/Electron framework toolchain and user-modified DLL replacement have not been built or verified by this material provision.

The local Windows GNU rebuild retains every original Chrome codec configuration macro, all 53 export names and ordinals, and the original Electron source patch. Exact Opus/build-helper sources, restored upstream build files, R0 Winpthreads linkage recipe and licenses are included.

A bounded paired stock/rebuilt DLL probe resolved all exports and used 24 APIs. Self-generated PCM WAV decoded exactly and Opus sample difference was zero. This is scoped component evidence, not a whole Electron or all-codec certification.

Complete original runtime sources, exact bootstrap pins, source tree, build/strip/relink controls and original licenses are supplied. Bootstrap binary packages are obtained separately, not embedded as source.
The six target libraries were actually rebuilt and statically verified; the selected combination passed seven fixed-point xTB cases with actual loader path/hash observations.
The two locally authored corresponding-source controls have the explicit per-directory MIT additional grant. SY-Studio application terms remain unchanged.

Twelve complete original source archives include the main scientific program and eleven actual static subprojects. The clean preferred-source tree contains 2539 checked files including 947 unchanged scientific source files.
Thirty-eight complete build-only overlays, twenty-four original licenses and exact Meson/Ninja/GCC/OpenBLAS/VC inputs accompany the actual successful build evidence and 64 MiB stack flags.

The parameterized local source controller provides plan, prepare, build and explicit local-modified modes. The per-directory MIT additional grant covers only the stated corresponding-source controls and local overlay changes.

ES-authored H-only initial-velocity modification: exact patch, unchanged upstream archive and actual build/source receipt are supplied under build-support/xtb-gnu/es-initial-velocity/. The new executable uses the unchanged published OpenBLAS 0.3.33 runtime/parameters; scientific acceptance is separate.
Native mctc-lib0.5.2 statically embeds jonquil0.3.0 and toml-f0.5.0; the shared toml-f used by tblite is0.5.2. Sources, package recipes and licenses are distinct from the older bundled0.5.1 snapshot.
Rebuild Fortran modules together for the selected compiler ABI. Preserve the native LP64 BLAS/LAPACK forwarding route; NumPy and SciPy BLAS are separate.
The explicit native GCC runtime is16.2.0, separate from the independent xTB GNU13.2 runtime.

libquadmath retains LGPL2.1 and individual file notices; libgcc/libgfortran/libgomp retain their applicable GPL and Runtime Library Exception. The package-wide generic license is not substituted for libquadmath.
Supplied GCC source omits only one non-build upstream Go core test fixture; original and derived identities and retained-member equivalence are recorded.
